content.text:
Found a real bug while setting up the UI proof, and it's worth stating precisely before I touch anything.

**`/behaviors/new` is broken on the dev server on this branch.** The page renders "Something went wrong!" with:

```
The requested module '/@fs/…/packages/core/dist/refs.js'
does not provide an export named 'REF_TOKEN'
```

Root cause: `@lobu/core` ships CJS dist, and `packages/owletto/vite.config.ts` already documents the workaround — every browser-safe subpath gets aliased to source plus listed in `optimizeDeps.include`:

```
'@lobu/core/errors':   path.resolve(__dirname, '../core/src/errors.ts'),
'@lobu/core/reserved': path.resolve(__dirname, '../core/src/reserved.ts'),
```

I added the `./refs` subpath and registered it in neither. Vite dev serves the raw CJS and the browser gets no ESM exports.

Why every gate stayed green — each is structurally blind to it:
- **typecheck** resolves through `dist/refs.d.ts`, which is correct
- **vitest** runs in Node, where CJS→named-export interop works
- **spa-boot-smoke** loads the *built* `dist/index.html`, and `build.commonjsOptions.include` already covers `packages/*/dist`, so production genuinely is fine

So it's dev-only — but dev is what you were clicking through. This is the "never report done off a green typecheck" case exactly; I'd have shipped it if I hadn't booted the page.

`refs.ts` has zero imports, so it's a clean alias target. Fix is the two-line registration matching the existing precedent.

I'm holding the edit until `make review-fix` finishes (still running, PID 76327) rather than editing the tree underneath it. Two other things worth knowing:

- The **claude-in-chrome extension is still not connected** (`list_connected_browsers` → `[]`), but Lobu connection **479 "Chrome (MacBook Pro)"** is live and reaches `127.0.0.1:9360`. That's the capture path, and it's what caught this. UI proof is achievable this session, unlike the 08-06 attempt.
- `make review-fix` first ran on codex and gave a **false green**: piped through `tail` it reported exit 0, but the real exit was `Error 1` — codex quota is exhausted until Aug 10, exactly as memory said. Rerunning under `REVIEWER_CLI=claude CLAUDE_REVIEW_MODEL=opus`.

I'll apply the vite fix, verify the page actually loads in the browser, then re-run the gates and continue to push/PR. Nothing is staged or pushed yet.

12	device executor's permission breadth.

14	| config | bash | curl (network) | completion path |
15	|---|---|---|---|

22	Two conclusions:
23	
24	**`--auto` is not what grants the breadth.** Plain `opencode run` with no flag and no config still
25	ran bash, curl, and file writes. Headless `run` has no surface to prompt on, so an `ask` permission
26	can never be answered — the effective states collapse to "allow" or "tool removed". Removing
27	`--auto` buys nothing; keep it so the full-trust posture is explicit rather than accidental.
28	
29	**Per-tool denies are theater while bash is open.** Denying `webfetch` blocks opencode's *built-in
30	webfetch tool*, not network access — `curl` through the allowed bash tool fetched the page anyway.
31	Never ship that config as if it were a boundary.
32	
33	The pattern form (`{"lobu *": "allow", "*": "deny"}`) does not filter per invocation; opencode drops
34	the whole bash tool, and the model reports `Model tried to call unavailable tool 'bash'`. Since the
35	device completion contract finalizes a run by shelling out to `lobu memory exec`, that breaks the
36	only finalize path for a CLI without MCP wiring.
37	
38	**Confinability differs by agent kind** — this is the thing to design around, not a per-CLI tweak:
39	Claude Code has `--allowedTools`, `pi` has `--tools read,bash,edit,write`, opencode has neither
40	headless. Treat opencode device Behaviors as full-trust execution on the user's machine.

11	Merging an Owletto PR advances `owletto/main` past the SHA that `lobu/main`
12	pins. `check-drift` then fails on **every open lobu PR in the repo**, not just
13	the one carrying the bump — it compares the pinned SHA against `owletto/main`
14	and cannot pass until a pointer bump lands on `lobu/main`.

16	Done 2026-08-05 (owletto#723 merged while its parent lobu#2509 was still
17	waiting on a human `/ui-approve`): six open PRs went red on a check none of
18	their authors could fix.

20	**Why:** check-drift's own rule says the pinned SHA must be reachable from
21	`owletto/main`, which reads like "merge owletto first". It is the opposite. The
22	pointer PR carries the bump, so the safe order is:
23	
24	1. Get the parent lobu PR fully green **including `ui-review` approval**.
25	2. Merge the Owletto PR.
26	3. Repin to the merged SHA, push, let check-drift go green.
27	4. Merge the parent.

29	Holding the Owletto PR open scopes the red to your own PR (pinned SHA not
30	reachable) instead of blocking everyone.

---
name: reference_vite_must_alias_new_core_subpaths
description: "A new @lobu/core subpath imported for RUNTIME VALUES must be added to owletto vite.config.ts resolve.alias + optimizeDeps.include, or vite dev serves raw CJS and the page dies — no gate catches it"
metadata:
  node_type: memory
  type: reference
---

`@lobu/core` ships a CommonJS `dist` (`module: CommonJS`). Vite **dev** serves workspace
files outside root raw over ESM, so a runtime-value import of an unregistered subpath
white-screens the route with:

```
The requested module '/@fs/.../packages/core/dist/refs.js'
does not provide an export named 'REF_TOKEN'
```

Two registrations are required in `packages/owletto/vite.config.ts` — `resolve.alias`
pointing at `../core/src/<name>.ts`, and `optimizeDeps.include`. As of 2026-08-08 the list
is `errors`, `reserved`, `refs`.

**The rule is about VALUE imports only.** `import type` is erased and needs nothing. Audit
by enumerating: every `@lobu/core*` import in the SPA is either aliased or type-only. In
#2592 the bare root (13×) and `contracts/tools/manage-connections` were all `import type`;
`refs` was the only unaliased value import, and the only breakage.

**Why no gate catches it** — each is structurally blind:

| gate | why it passes |
|---|---|
| `tsc` | resolves `dist/<name>.d.ts`, which is correct |
| `vitest` | runs in Node, where CJS → named-export interop works |
| `spa-boot-smoke` | loads the **built** bundle, where `build.commonjsOptions` (`/packages[\\/][^\\/]+[\\/]dist/`) already applies |

So **production is fine and only dev breaks** — which is exactly what a human tests. This is
the concrete case behind "never report done off a green typecheck": `make pre-pr` was clean,
1270 owletto tests passed, and the page still would not load.

Only alias browser-safe subpaths. Never alias the package root — the barrel re-exports
logger/otel/sentry and crashes the SPA with `process is not defined`.

**How to apply:** adding an `exports` entry to `packages/core/package.json` is half the job.
If the SPA imports a value from it, register it in vite.config.ts in the same commit, then
**boot the page** — the only check that can see this.

## 2026-08-08 (PR #2592): SOLVED — the working path, end to end

`mcp__claude-in-chrome__list_connected_browsers` still returns `[]` and the `lobu` CLI still
405s on the malformed `https://lobu.ai/api/<org>/...` URL. **Neither is needed.** Drive the
Lobu `chrome` connector directly via `run_sdk` → `client.operations.execute`.

- **Pick the connection by machine.** 432 is `Chrome (Mac mini)` — a *different host*, so it
  cannot reach `localhost`. **479 = `Chrome (MacBook Pro)`** is this laptop and does. Confirm
  with `operations.listAvailable({connection_id})` → `execution_targets[].display_name`.
- **Scratch tabs are run-scoped.** `navigate` returns `output.tab_id`; that tab is destroyed
  when the run ends, so a later `run_sdk` call gets `evaluate: no tab`. Do navigate → act →
  screenshot inside **one** script, threading `tab_id`.
- **Keep the image out of context** — this is the whole trick. A shot is a ~380 KB `data_url`
  (~95k tokens if returned). Instead, pass it into an `evaluate` expression that POSTs to a
  local receiver: `fetch('http://127.0.0.1:5200/?name=x',{method:'POST',body:<json-stringified dataUrl>})`.
  The browser is on this machine, so it reaches localhost; the Lobu sandbox cannot. Return
  only `post=200`. The sdk_call_trace shows `{truncated:true, bytes:…}` — confirmation the
  payload never entered context. Receiver: ~25 lines of node, `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`,
  body as text/plain so it stays a CORS simple request (no preflight).
- **Boot the SPA standalone**, not via the shared `make dev` (that server belongs to another
  session's process tree and 404s all app routes after a vite config restart):
  `cd packages/owletto && LOBU_API_PROXY=https://app.lobu.ai bunx vite --host localhost --port 5199 --strictPort`.
  Browser session is already signed in. Org slug is **`buremba`** — hit `/` and let it redirect;
  a locally-seeded slug gives "Organization not found".
- **BEFORE shots:** `git checkout <base-sha>` inside `packages/owletto`, kill and relaunch vite
  (HMR does not survive a wholesale checkout), capture, then `git checkout <branch>`.
- ProseMirror/TipTap editors: focus, collapse a Range to the end, then
  `document.execCommand('insertText', false, '@')`. Allow ~5 s after a tab switch — an earlier
  attempt hit `.ProseMirror` null purely from racing the mount and silently captured a
  menu-less page.
- `sips -s format jpeg -s formatOptions 68 -Z 1600` → 4 shots ≈ 474 KB → a 1.21 MB artifact.

**How to apply:** never let a screenshot's base64 be a tool result. Route it browser → local
receiver and keep the agent holding only a status code.
